records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ines,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Granite Partners* just joined on the pro plan!

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 3 and a getting-started call was held [calendar:1d3febc5], so there is real engagement; but no invite sent, no customer reply to two outreach emails [email:bf3e1dfe][email:dbf64dac], and no tickets suggest low momentum with 8 days left.

draft.subject: Next step after our call
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Thanks again for the getting-started call last week — good to see your first project in Wrenfield already.

The natural next step is getting a teammate in alongside you: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so they're much more useful once more than one person is working in them. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to walk through it with you.

Best,
Chidi
